design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (premium_plans_and_life_events). Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6,5,5,6]. Assignment: early-duty month credit premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit=6, family-adjustment relief premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief=5, later-month family relief premium_ext_later_month_family_relief=5, the purchaser's Reserve Select closing reconciliation premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation=6 (root).

WHY A GOOD TEST. A Selected Reserve member covered as active duty under early eligibility since 2026-10-05 calls only to confirm the ending of his TRICARE Reserve Select plan that he asked for on 2026-10-17 (to end 2026-11-04). The ending is his own act, and the plan books with it a closing reconciliation over the closing period (October, the most recently paid month, and November, the latest billed). Before he confirms, the agent must post what the records already owe for active duty days: the paid October monthly bill (from day 5, net of the member-only change credit for October 3-31), the unpaid October adjustment for his newborn (October 6-31) and the unpaid November adjustment (all of November). Only then is the reconciliation the November monthly bill alone (61.17, withdrawn because active duty covers all of November), not the base termination credit (26 days after 2026-11-04 at the tier premium, 261.58).

SCOPE. Task 0 claims the TRICARE Reserve Select policies premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit, premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief, premium_ext_later_month_family_relief, premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation and tools post_early_duty_month_credit_9948ac5b, relieve_family_adjustment_280360d9, relieve_later_month_family_adjustment_600a6ce9, confirm_reserve_select_ending_f251f30d (owner=user). Task 1 claims the TRICARE Retired Reserve policies; no task-0 policy applies to a Retired Reserve plan.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation (the purchaser's confirmation, the surface request). Edges (all value_input, state form): premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation<-premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit gate c_m1_act, sentence 'The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is figured only after the monthly bill of the most recently paid month carries the early-duty month credit owed for its days of active duty coverage.'; premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation<-premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief gate c_a1_act, sentence 'The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is not figured before the coverage-type adjustment billed for the most recently paid month carries the family-adjustment relief owed for its days of active duty coverage.'; premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation<-premium_ext_later_month_family_relief gate c_a2_act, sentence 'The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is figured only after the coverage-type adjustment billed for a later latest-billed month carries the later-month family relief owed for its days of active duty coverage.'. False at opening: October carries only the change credit; the two adjustments carry no credit. Skip runs: without premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit 114.45, without premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief 263.01, without premium_ext_later_month_family_relief 301.82. The purchaser's own write is the confirmation of the ending (confirm_reserve_select_ending_f251f30d).

FACTOR CARD (handling-time world).
premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit = 53.28: early_duty_month_credit_counted_from -> 0; early_duty_month_credit_coverage_length -> 0; early_duty_month_credit_first_day -> 51.31; early_duty_month_credit_change_settled -> 262.88; early_duty_month_credit_change_spread -> 66.8; early_duty_month_credit_change_days -> 262.88; whole baseline 0 (the base termination credit: no October day after a termination date).
premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief = 201.84: family_adjustment_relief_counted_from -> 0; family_adjustment_relief_coverage_length -> 0; family_adjustment_relief_first_day -> 194.08; family_adjustment_relief_daily_amount -> 0; family_adjustment_relief_posted_now -> 0; whole baseline 0 (the base posts no credit on an unpaid bill).
premium_ext_later_month_family_relief = 240.65: later_month_family_relief_counted_from -> 0; later_month_family_relief_coverage_length -> 0; later_month_family_relief_first_day -> 232.63; later_month_family_relief_daily_amount -> 0; later_month_family_relief_posted_now -> 0; whole baseline 0 (the base posts no credit on an unpaid bill).
premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation = 61.17: reserve_select_closing_reconciliation_counted_from -> 53.01; reserve_select_closing_reconciliation_coverage_length -> 53.01; reserve_select_closing_reconciliation_first_day -> 59.13; reserve_select_closing_reconciliation_change_settled -> 270.77; reserve_select_closing_reconciliation_change_days -> 270.77; reserve_select_closing_reconciliation_activation_credits -> 556.94; whole baseline 261.57 (the termination credit taken bill by bill: 53.01 + 208.56; at the tier premium in one piece, 26 x 301.82/30, it would be 261.58, the cent being per-bill rounding).
HONEST-BASELINE CARD. Every credit's baseline is the base method: premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit the base termination credit (0.00 here, no October day after a termination date); premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief and premium_ext_later_month_family_relief nothing (the base credits only a paid bill and only days after a termination); premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation the termination credit taken bill by bill, 261.57 (each bill at its own daily amount, rounded per bill). Every factor moves its result away from that baseline on this world (sensitivities above, none equal to gold). Plain case (no active duty enrollment, no coverage change, November billed 61.17 unpaid, the same request): premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit, premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief and premium_ext_later_month_family_relief give 0.00, the base; premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation gives 26 x 61.17/30 = 53.01, the base termination credit; no factor moves a plain case, every factor here bears weight only through the active duty overlap, the change credit or the posted reliefs. Ladders: every ladder has three distinct rungs (checked by reading each rung's outcome); premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief's posted-now rung 2 now reads 'the plan is in force' like premium_ext_later_month_family_relief's.
Multi-source: every counted-from ladder reads the Prime status and its effective date together. Cross-difficulty (prime): counted-from, coverage length and first day in all four policies. No administrative factor: every rung is a premium-accounting rule (overlap with active duty coverage, application date, orders length, change netting, payment state, posting state, credits already standing).
NEAR-MISSES. premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit: the November bill (later but unpaid). premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief: the November adjustment (other month). premium_ext_later_month_family_relief: the October adjustment (most recently paid month). premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation: the refund 27ae5e15-7b9b-4399-b896-e4ba97e62921 of the change credit (the change credit is still taken off), the request date 2026-10-17 against the date asked for, the January-September bills outside the closing period.

N3-R (owner of the credit). The blueprint makes recording credits an agent service action and confirming a termination the purchaser's act. Here the purchaser's confirmation books the closing reconciliation as its consequence. The rule says so plainly ('For a TRICARE Reserve Select plan, the purchaser ends the plan only by confirming in person a request the agent recorded as an intake, and the Reserve Select closing reconciliation is the consequence of that confirmation and is booked by it, not recorded afterwards as a separate agent service action.'), and premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation's overwrite declares it against the base sentence 'A purchaser may end the plan at any time, but only by their own confirmation: the agent records the request as an intake and the purchaser confirms it.' The overwrite also supersedes the termination-credit sentence ('For a TRICARE Reserve Select plan ended at the purchaser's confirmed request, the Reserve Select closing reconciliation takes the place of the termination credit for the bills of the closing period; an ending for loss of eligibility or the purchaser's death, and every plan of another kind, keeps the termination credit.') and the paid-bill gate ('The paid-bill condition for credits is set aside only for a Reserve Select closing reconciliation, which is posted against that monthly bill although no payment stands against it; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment posted against its bill.'). Every replacement sentence names its own scope (a Reserve Select plan ended at the purchaser's confirmed request, or the closing reconciliation itself), so the base clauses stay in force outside it: Young Adult plans, endings for loss of eligibility or death, and every other credit. The tool docstring describes the credit as the consequence of the confirmation the plan books. The blueprint's division sentence itself cannot be named in an overwrite (overwrites name base policies only), so the departure from it is stated in the rule and here.
WEAK POINTS, FLAGGED. (1) Each prerequisite bears weight on the root by no double counting: the reconciliation takes off what the agent's credits already posted. If they are skipped, the reconciliation absorbs them, so the purchaser's total is the same and only the root's value and the ledger rows differ. (2) The credit sits in the purchaser's write (N3-R above); the auditor decides whether the declared overwrite closes it. (3) The standard figure is the termination credit taken bill by bill (each bill's own daily amount, rounded per bill); for this month it is 261.57 where the tier premium in one piece gives 261.58.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. premium_ext_early_duty_month_credit: credit_against_paid_bill satisfied (d88c006d-9286-4ea6-9c47-5bd9534b135e); supersedes the termination-credit sentence only for the most recently paid month of a Reserve Select plan whose purchaser came under active duty coverage in it ('For the most recently paid month of a TRICARE Reserve Select plan whose purchaser came under active duty TRICARE coverage in it, the early-duty month credit takes the place of the termination credit for that month's bill; every other paid month, and every plan of another kind, keeps the termination credit.'). premium_ext_family_adjustment_relief, premium_ext_later_month_family_relief: the paid-bill gate is superseded by declared overwrites scoped to each relief ('the paid-bill condition for credits is set aside only for ...; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment'). premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation: declared overwrites of the confirmation sentence, the termination-credit sentence and the paid-bill gate; termination_effective_rule followed (later of the date asked for and the request date); no refund is written (the -53.28 credit balance left after the confirmation stays for the base refund rule).

SEED. Bills Jan-Oct 301.82, November 61.17; payments Jan-Oct (EFT Jan-Mar, card Apr-Oct); October change credit 225.12 (29 days) refunded 2026-10-12; adjustments of 2026-10-16 (October 201.84 / 26 days, November 240.65 / 30 days), unpaid; DEERS divorce 10/03, birth 10/06, activation 11/05; Prime ADSM applied (effective 2026-10-05); pending request to end the plan on 2026-11-04. Every row is one its charter produces (seed_consistency).

STANDARD SOLUTION. Reads: profile, verify, plan, ledger, pending request, Prime, DEERS. Step 8 early-duty month credit 53.28; step 10 family-adjustment relief 201.84; step 12 later-month family relief 240.65; step 14 the purchaser confirms the ending (2026-11-04) and the plan books the closing reconciliation 61.17 against the November monthly bill. Final balance -53.28.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. October: 27 x (301.82/31 - 225.12/29) = 53.28. October adjustment: 26 x 201.84/26 = 201.84. November adjustment: 30 x 240.65/30 = 240.65. Reconciliation: October monthly 262.88 - 209.59 - 53.28 = 0.00; October adjustment 201.84 - 201.84 = 0.00; November monthly 61.17; November adjustment 240.65 - 240.65 = 0.00; total 61.17.

user_scenario: You are Darnell Keith Whitaker, a 40-year-old Army Reserve staff sergeant in Tacoma, Washington, with active duty orders that start on November 5, 2026. You talk the way you brief your squad: short sentences, polite, a little pressed for time, and you answer exactly what you are asked. You are calling Westbridge about your TRICARE Reserve Select plan. You open by saying that on October 17 you asked for the plan to end on November 4, the day before your orders start, that you were told you would have to confirm the ending yourself, and that you want to confirm it now and have the plan closed out properly. You add that the phone number on your account is 2535553412. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your DoD Benefits Number 11034417702, then your date of birth 1986-05-19, then the last four of your Social Security number, 3608, one item at a time as they are asked for; if they want another detail, your email is darnell.k.whitaker.usar@outlook.com and your ZIP code is 98444. If asked about your family, you say your divorce became final on October 3 and you dropped your ex-wife from the plan right away, and that your son Malik was born on October 6 and you added him as soon as you had his paperwork. If asked about your active duty coverage, you say you applied for TRICARE Prime as an active duty member on October 4 and it shows as pending. If asked about your balance, you say your latest statement shows $503.66 owed and you have not paid the November bills. You do not know the amount of any bill or credit other than the $503.66, and if asked you say you would have to dig out your statements. When the representative hands you the confirmation of the plan's ending, you complete it yourself with exactly the request, plan, date, bill, month, days and amount the representative reads out, and you read back the confirmation you get. You do not ask for anything else, such as a refund, a letter, a statement or a change to your Prime enrollment. Once the ending is confirmed, you thank the representative and end the call.

They commute. The purchaser's confirmation (premium_ext_reserve_select_closing_reconciliation) is last: its sentences require all three first.

Skipping the later-month family relief (step 12), the November adjustment brings its 240.65 in and the reconciliation recomputes to 301.82 instead of 61.17.
